title: Scan axis (GalvoScanDesigner)

reads.fallback: a conversion factor of 1 (V per um)

message: GalvoScanDesigner requires 'vel_max' (µm/µs) and 'acc_max' (µm/µs^2) in managerProperties for scanning positioner(s) {names}. Add realistic values (example_sted uses vel_max=0.1, acc_max=0.0001); without them the smooth-scan spline degenerates.

vel_max.description: Maximum axis velocity in µm/µs; GalvoScanDesigner builds the smooth-scan spline to it.

jerk_max.description: Optional maximum jerk in µm/µs³; sets the jerk-transition time of the spline.

conversionFactor.description: Micrometres per volt for this axis; GalvoScanDesigner assumes 1 when it is absent.

smoothScan.description: Whether GalvoScanDesigner sweeps this axis continuously (galvo) or steps and holds it per pixel (piezo, stage). Absent: decided by the device name -- 'mock' devices are stepped, everything else sweeps. A stepped axis needs no vel_max/acc_max.
